infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NoteCal uses the camera to scan barcodes on food products and take photos of meals or weight-tracking progress.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NoteCal accesses your photo library so you can attach progress photos to weight entries and analyze meals from existing photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: NoteCal saves photos you take inside the app to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is requested by the camera framework. NoteCal only takes still photos and barcode scans, and does not record audio.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: NoteCal reads your body weight from Apple Health so you can see your full weight history without re-entering it.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: NoteCal writes your logged meals (calories, macros, water) and weight entries to Apple Health so they appear alongside your other health data.
